description: This is a Java source file defining the EntityCache class, which manages caching of entity objects within the Apache OFBiz framework. It provides methods to get, put, and remove cached entities based on primary keys and conditions.

classes.name: EntityCache
classes.description: A cache implementation for entity objects, supporting retrieval, insertion, and removal of entities based on primary keys and conditions.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a GenericValue entity from the cache using its primary key.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Inserts a GenericValue entity into the cache based on its primary key.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Inserts a GenericValue entity into the cache, marking it as immutable before caching.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes entities from the cache that match a specified condition within an entity name.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a specific GenericValue entity from the cache.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes an entity from the cache based on its primary key.
